project.name: Boom Bap Vocal Emotional Slow Build

arrangement.notes: The arrangement builds energy slowly focusing on vocal variations using multiple chop techniques.

event_markers.label: Vocal chops intro
event_markers.reason: Introduce micro, phrase, reverse, vocal, and stutter chops techniques

event_markers.label: Vocal chops peak intensity
event_markers.reason: Emotional high point with vocal chopped variations

event_markers.label: Bridge with micro chops
event_markers.reason: Add variation with micro chops for emotional depth

event_markers.label: Final hook reverse chops
event_markers.reason: Culminate arrangement with intense vocal chops variations

micro_chops.description: Short, chopped fragments for rhythmic vocal texture

phrase_chops.description: Phrase-level vocal chops to maintain melodic flow

reverse_chops.description: Reverse sample treatment for atmospheric effect

vocal_chops.description: Vocal snippets chopped and rearranged for variation

stutter_chops.description: Stuttered vocal fragments for rhythmic emphasis

sound_intent.focus: vocal chops with emotional expression and textured variation
sound_intent.energy_profile: slow build from low to high emotional energy

designer_intent.goal: Create a vocally-driven Boom Bap arrangement with slow energy build emphasizing emotional vocal chops.

presetor_intent.objective: Apply preset chain optimized for vocal chopping, emphasizing clarity and dynamic expression over slow buildup.

sensei_drum.brief: Design drum patterns complementing the slow build energy profile with focus on Boom Bap style percussion.

bass_generator.brief: Generate basslines that support harmonic mood without overpowering the vocal-focused arrangement.

harmony_generator.brief: Create chord progressions and pads to add emotional depth and support vocal textures minimally.

melody_generator.brief: Add subtle melodic elements that work as background support to vocal chops without conflicting.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement flow ensuring vocal chops are featured with a gradual energy increase throughout the track.

presetor.brief: Manage preset chains and effects for each channel, focusing on enhancing vocal chop clarity and emotional impact.

songgps.brief: Maintain arrangement coherence and pacing matching the slow build and emotional focus specified.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare for final mix stage ensuring unprocessed channel routing is retained for flexible vocal chop treatment.
